Unique Research · Capital monthly · March 18, 2024

February 2024 AIGC financing — China & overseas headlines, active investors, secondary-market color, and named deals from the CN text. Methodology note and ~14 CN charts attach on ingest. Do not invent table rows from charts; only figures stated in CN prose are treated as facts here. (CN typo “7103.6亿” for Moonshot normalized to ~¥7.1B / $1B per surrounding text.)

Contents

  1. February financing snapshot
  2. China financing
  3. Overseas financing
  4. Secondary-market trading
  5. Named deals
  6. Report statement

Methodology / data note

Word clouds and financing boards draw on Xiniu (烯牛) platform data plus Unique Research inference from public information. Secondary market cites East Money (as of Feb 29). For research reference only — Unique Research accepts no legal liability; cite Unique Research when using. Charts (~14) attach on ingest.

01 · February financing snapshot

  • Global AIGC financing Feb: ¥22.96B, +200% vs January — capital attraction continuing to rise
  • Series B and later: 93.0% of financing amount
  • Largest global & China check: Moonshot (月之暗面) — ~$1B (~¥7.1B); disclosed as the company’s 2nd raise; led by Alibaba; Sequoia China, Xiaohongshu, Meituan, China Merchants / CMC follow
  • Deals >¥100M: 21 events, 52.5% of count
  • China Feb total: ¥8.16B across 19 deals — +¥7.486B vs prior month

YTD through Feb (country color)

  • China — 42 deals (overtook U.S. 31 by count)
  • U.S. — amount lead ¥12.531B
  • France 4 deals / ¥3.806B; UK 4 / ¥1.816B
  • Also Canada, Germany, Japan, Israel, Egypt, Singapore, Netherlands, Austria — fewer deals, still material participation

02 · China financing

2.1 Active investors (YTD through Feb)

By deal count: MiraclePlus (奇绩创坛) — 16 (#1). Sequoia China, Hillhouse Ventures, Sinovation, Lenovo Capital, BlueRun — 8 each (#2 band).

By cumulative amount: Alibaba >¥3.5B (#1, driven by Moonshot $1B lead). Same Moonshot round also lifts Meituan, Sequoia China, CMC, Xiaohongshu into top-10 amount names.

2.2 Hot projects

Moonshot $1B; Meituan full acquisition of ZCOOL (站酷) ~$39.64M (>¥280M). ¥100M–¥1B band names cited: Aochuang Guangnian, Haomo.AI, Wanxiang Electronics, Zhixingyun, Weiding Tech, Bohan Intelligent, etc. Smaller: Global Murphy, Transn, SiliconFlow, Babel AI, etc.

2.3 By stage (Jan–Feb)

  • Early-stage events: 14 (>30% of China deals) — still early industry
  • Undisclosed / equity / strategic lumped as “strategic”: 21 strategic investments in 2 months
  • 3 acquisitions — early consolidation signal
  • Early-stage amount: ¥0.384B total; avg ~¥27.43M/deal; Series A: 5 projects / ¥0.242B
  • Acquisition amount: ¥0.482B

03 · Overseas financing

3.1 Hot projects (Jan–Feb amount board, CN prose)

  • Mistral AI — ~¥3.0B (#1)
  • Lambda — ~¥2.472B
  • Genmo — ~¥2.131B; Anthropic — ~¥2.0B
  • KAO Data — ~¥1.463B; Glean — ~¥1.421B; Abridge — ~¥1.066B
  • Smaller: Wisedocs, Collov, FlowGPT, SEMRON (~¥50–100M band)

3.2 Active overseas investors

>200 institutions invested overseas AI in Jan–Feb. Five firms did 3 deals each. By Unique Research estimated cumulative: NEA ~$2.328B (#1); a16z ~$912M; Kleiner Perkins ~$652M; Lightspeed ~$645M; General Catalyst ~$217M. Single largest check cited: Microsoft ~$3B class.

3.3 By stage

  • Early-stage events: 38 (>60% of overseas count)
  • Growth/mature amount share higher than China
  • Strategic: ¥9.802B (#1 amount); Series C ¥3.800B; seed ¥0.979B; angel ¥0.888B; A ¥1.649B; B ¥3.228B; D ¥1.421B; E ¥0.533B; acquisitions ¥0.100B

04 · Secondary market (East Money, as of Feb 29)

AIGC concept index: 1,396.43, +11.22% MoM; turnover ¥691.9B; turnover ratio 70.97%.

Top 5 gainers: Insight Group (因赛集团, 300781) 54.62 / +72.85%; ChineseAll (中文在线, 300364) 28.87 / +61.38%; Guomai Culture (国脉文化) 16.76 / +55.91%; WhenRai (当虹科技, 688039) 35.00 / +45.53%; Anoky (安诺其, 300067) 3.73 / +38.66%.

Company blurbs (brand marketing; digital publishing; data governance; video codec/AI; fine chemicals) are in CN text — charts attach on ingest.

05 · Named deals (China)

  • Tushen Zhihe — hundreds-of-thousands-RMB angel (Chengmei Capital) after photon-core-valley seed; AI protein design (ProteinEngine)
  • LINKER / Lianhui — multi-¥100M strategic (China Mobile industry fund lead; Qianhai FoF vehicles)
  • Haomo.AI × Chengdu Wufa — AV + last-mile logistics (Great Wall spinout)
  • Wanxiang Electronics — multi-investor round (West Hi-Tech, etc.); graphics transport / SD-GPU / vGAI
  • Zhizhen Cloud × Jingxi culture-tourism fund — digital audit / AI mid-platform
  • Youzhi Chuangxin — Lihui lead, Huagai follow; brain-inspired SNN / CLAS
  • ARGOOZ × iFLYTEK — AR
  • Moonshot — $1B Alibaba-led; valuation ~$2.5B (~8× prior); Kimi 200k-char context (then); largest China AI startup check since ChatGPT era as stated
  • Weiwu Tech — Lakeside Shannan / Zhiyi / Amoeba / Jingchen — photoreal digital humans (NextHuman)
  • Jinyu Intelligent — Series A led by Zhiwang, followed by GSR; AIGC interviewer + LLM engineer training path
  • Zhixingyun × Anoky — GPU cloud / >500P managed compute
  • ZCOOL × Meitu — full acquisition; MiracleVision design ecosystem
  • Transn × Jiadao private capital — AI language services
  • Baiying × Baidu & Hubei industrial finance — AI digital workforce
  • Weiding / Medalsoft — 100% acquired by SoftwareOne
  • Qiaoyi Zhizao — industrial defect detection
  • Turing DeepVision — luxury authentication AI hardware
  • Bohan Intelligent — Haier Haichuang funds as new shareholders
  • Huayin Tech × TusStar — generative digital human / A/V engine (Mar target for first published works)

06 · Named deals (overseas)

  • Wisedocs — Information Venture Partners lead; medical-record AI for insurance claims; U.S. HQ in Florida; 3.5× client growth
  • HireAra — £450k seed for recruiter AI candidate showcase
  • Proofcheck — €500k pre-seed (BackBone lead; Angel Invest, Gernot Singer, Kyle Kosic)
  • Brix — Freedom Fund etc. lead, Plug and Play follow; AI cross-border hiring for U.S. firms
  • Colossyan — $22M Series A (Lakestar); AI video from script <30 min; 600% growth; Porsche/Vodafone/Paramount
  • Lambda — US Innovative Technology Fund, B Capital et al.; 100k+ Lambda Cloud regs; H100 early access
  • Anthropic — Qualcomm Ventures, Intuit; valuation reports ~$15B
  • Altavo — $5.4M Series A (Sofinnova lead) — silent-speech rehab
  • Bioptimus — $35M seed (Sofinnova lead; Bpifrance, Frst, Cathay, Headline, Hummingbird, NJF, Owkin, Top Harvest, Xavier Niel) — biology foundation model
  • Abridge — Lightspeed & Redpoint lead — clinical conversation → structured notes
  • Talus Network — $3M first round (Polychain lead) — MoveVM on-chain AI agents
  • DeepX — targeting ₩120B (~$90M); partial from Skylake, Timefolio — AI chips; Hyundai-Kia / Posco DX partners
  • Genmo — ≥$30M from NEA (The Information) — text→image/animation/4s video
  • Mistral AI × Microsoft minority stake; Mistral Large on Azure; Dec 2023 valuation €2B
  • Glean — $100M Series C (Sequoia lead per CN; Lightspeed/KP also cited); $1B valuation — workplace search
  • NLX — $12M Series A — conversational AI self-serve
  • Inkitt — $37M (Khosla lead; NEA, KP); $400M valuation
  • FlowGPT — $10M pre-A (Goodwater)
  • PhotoRoom — $43M strategic (Balderton lead; YC, Aglaé)
  • Collov — $10M Series A (GoldenHome lead) — AI interior design + commerce
  • Ideogram AI — ~$80M Series A expected (a16z lead; Index/SVA, Redpoint cited)

07 · Report statement

Unique Research is Unique Capital’s new-business innovation research arm — China & go-global enterprise services, new marketing/retail/experience, and tech × traditional industries. Data for research reference only; no legal liability for accuracy or investment outcomes. Cite Unique Research when republishing.

14 CN images/charts (financing boards, country maps, secondary-market); attach on ingest. Do not invent table rows.

— END —
